verdict.rationale: Claude Design can apply a team's design system to every project automatically. It can also pull the design system in from Claude Code via /design-sync and build with real components imported from a codebase. Together these give some cross-project reuse of components and styles. Nothing in the evidence describes a published library model, or any way to review, accept or control updates when the source changes. missing for 10: publishing shared component/style libraries, versioning, controlled update review/acceptance when the source changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of design-system syncing.
